data.long_meaning: The name रोशन is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘रोशन’, which means 'bright', 'shining', or 'radiant'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge and wisdom, is often depicted as 'रोशनि', meaning 'the radiant one'. The name रोशन carries the meaning “Light, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose रोशन usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
